A single direction can reach at most one signed root per unordered pair; two disjoint heavy pairs would exceed the total weight, so all reached coordinate pairs intersect. Every pairwise-intersecting graph-edge family is a star or triangle and has at most d-1 edges for d>=4. Summing vertex coverage constraints implies fractional and ordinary >=2d. The 2d explicit signed star directions with center magnitude d, all others magnitude 1 have exactly d-1 hits apiece and partition the 2d(d-1) roots; illuminating vertices suffices for all boundary faces.
